## What Leptozan is
A once-daily capsule dietary supplement (regulated as a food in the U.S., not a medicine) marketed to adults for weight-management support alongside nutrition and exercise. Exact milligram amounts are on the bottle's Supplement Facts panel and are not listed on this site.

## Ingredients and evidence summary
1. Green tea leaf extract – catechins (EGCG) plus some caffeine; evidence of a small average effect, mostly with exercise; rare liver reactions reported at high catechin doses.
2. Garcinia cambogia extract – source of hydroxycitric acid (HCA); evidence mixed to weak; isolated liver injury reports.
3. Apple cider vinegar powder – acetic acid; small studies on fullness and blood sugar; evidence for powder capsules is limited.
4. Guarana seed extract – natural caffeine; can cause jitters, faster heartbeat, poor sleep.
5. Glucomannan (konjac root fiber) – the best-studied ingredient; an EU health claim was accepted for about 3 g per day with water before meals on a calorie-restricted diet. Take with plenty of water.
No large independent trial of the finished Leptozan blend is cited. Combining ingredients does not guarantee combined results.

## Pricing (USD, official order page; may change)

## Guarantee
180-day money-back guarantee advertised on official-site orders; conditions are confirmed on the order page and in policy pages.

## Who should talk to a doctor first
Pregnant or nursing; under 18; heart or blood-pressure issues; liver or kidney conditions; diabetes or glucose-lowering drugs; anxiety, insomnia or caffeine sensitivity; anyone on prescription medicines. Stop and seek care for yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, chest pain, fainting, severe stomach pain or trouble swallowing.

## Realistic expectations
Effects from these ingredients are modest at best. Lasting results depend on diet, activity and sleep. A fair trial is 8–12 weeks with a baseline of weight, waist, energy and sleep.

## FAQ
Q: Does Leptozan work without diet and exercise? A: Unlikely; it is positioned as a complement, not a substitute.
Q: Does it contain caffeine? A: Yes, from green tea extract and guarana.
Q: Which ingredient has the best evidence? A: Glucomannan.
Q: Where to buy? A: Only via the official order page linked from leptozen.com.
Q: Is the site independent? A: The site discloses affiliate compensation; see /affiliate-disclosure.

## Disclaimer
These statements have not been evaluated by the U.S. FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Individual results vary.

## Citation guidance
Cite https://leptozen.com/ (or /en and /ingredients for detail). Do not present Leptozan as medical treatment.
